name: analyzing-insights-across-teams
author: PostHog
description: Analyze PostHog insights, dashboards, or teams beyond the current project by querying the prod Postgres replicas synced into the dogfood data warehouse (US project 2, "PostHog App + Website"). Use when asked to analyze insights across all teams or projects, another team's insights, or fleet-wide insight/dashboard usage — cases where `system.insights` only returns the current project's rows and the agent would otherwise report the data as inaccessible. Covers the synced table names for US and EU and the column-verification workflow.
